## What will Jar B's roots do?

In Jar B, only about 1 cm has been cut from the tip of each root. The rest of each root is still there, in the same kind of water as Jar A.

**Predict:** After their tips are cut, what will happen to the length of the roots in Jar B over the next few days?

options.text: They keep growing at the same speed as the roots in Jar A.
They grow faster than before, to make up for the part that was cut off.
They stop getting longer, even though most of each root is still there.
They grow more slowly than the roots in Jar A, but still get longer each day.
